subject: Urgent: Bluestreak - pricing carveout + MFN request (exec review needed)
messages:
From: Kendra Mason <kendra.mason@bluestreaksys.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Elliot Shaw <elliot.shaw@bluestreaksys.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed commercial terms / MFN + regional exclusivity

Irene —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Bluestreak is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the integration work your team showed. Our GC and procurement have a few commercial asks they insist on before we can sign:

- 25% ARR discount on committed spend of $1.2M (12-month term)
- A 12-month limited exclusivity in the Northeast territory for our use-case class (no co-sell clause)
- MFN on pricing for the first 24 months (our lawyers want a broad protection)

I attached our redlines to the Master SA (Bluestreak_Redlines_Master_SA.pdf). If you could flag anything non-starter that would be helpful — our counsel is eager to move fast.

Elliot (cc'd) is our procurement lead — he can run payment/co-term questions. We're aiming to sign before June 1 to align with our fiscal close.

Kendra

--
Kendra Mason
VP, Strategic Procurement
Bluestreak Systems
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed commercial terms / MFN + regional exclusivity

Team — escalating for quick exec decision. Summary of asks from Bluestreak: 25% discount on $1.2M ARR (12mo), 12-month regional exclusivity in NE vertical use-case, and a 24mo MFN on pricing. They've attached redlines (Bluestreak_Redlines_Master_SA.pdf).

My read:
- Discount: we can consider up to 20% at commit levels + shorter term (9-12mo) if they accept performance/uptime SLAs and achieve adoption milestones.
- Exclusivity: non-starter at company or product-level. Could tolerate a limited "go-to-market" restriction (no co-sell in a narrowly defined vertical segment) for 6 months max tied to revenue milestones and clawback.
- MFN: broad MFN is risky — exposes us to pricing leakage across deals. If we concede, it must be strictly scoped: (1) specific SKU/region, (2) capped duration (12 months), and (3) carve out pilot discounts and partner reseller adjustments.

Requesting: exec sign-off on a counterproposal we can present today: 20% max discount, 6-month limited GTM exclusivity with clawback, and a 12-month narrowly scoped MFN tied to the specific product SKU. Also need legal to confirm the redlines that are absolute blockers (data residency, audit rights, indemnity caps). Attached a quick deal summary (deal_summary_20290509.xlsx).

Please reply with Approve / Reject / Amend and any hard limits. We need a decision by 16:00 PT to keep their June 1 target viable.

Thanks — Irene

--
Irene Choi
Sr. Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed commercial terms / MFN + regional exclusivity

Irene + team — I support a firm cap at 20% discount with clear milestones. No exclusivity beyond a very narrow GTM window (6mo) and only if they hit adoption thresholds (≥60% of committed seats by month 6).

MFN: counter with a 12-month SKU-limited MFN that explicitly excludes partner/reseller pricing and any private pilot discounts. If legal can draft tight language, I think that's acceptable to close the deal.

Ben

--
Ben Carter | Head of Strategic Sales

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 13:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed commercial terms / MFN + regional exclusivity

Irene — good summary. Two quick executive points:

1) Commercial: I can greenlight a structured concession to accelerate closure if the deal meets both (a) minimum ARR threshold of $1.0M committed and (b) contract signing by 2029-06-01. Under that scenario I will approve a 20% discount with a motion to revert pricing to standard if they miss milestones.

2) Competitive protections: I will not approve open-ended exclusivity or an unrestricted MFN. Approve only if Legal + Finance confirm: a tightly scoped MFN (12mo, SKU-level), exclusivity limited to "non-commercial proof-of-concept activities" in a defined region for up to 6 months, and a clawback tied to revenue attainment.

Please get Legal's redline summary and a short risk bullet for my review (one pager). If that checks out, I authorize Sales to present the counter and sign subject to final Legal language.

-Markus

--
Markus Klein
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference

From: Elliot Shaw <elliot.shaw@bluestreaksys.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Kendra Mason <kendra.mason@bluestreaksys.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed commercial terms / MFN + regional exclusivity

Irene — appreciate the fast follow. Bluestreak is under fiscal pressure to lock by June 1; CFO wants a 25% discount and either a 12-month MFN or a contract clause guaranteeing parity if Redwood reduces price for similar customers. The exclusivity is a key ask for our sales motion in the Northeast.

We can accept a 6-month trial exclusivity if it is mutual (Bluestreak will share quarterly adoption metrics) and the MFN covers only the SKU priced in the attached redlines. Can you confirm if Redwood can route a revised counter (20% discount + 6mo limited exclusivity + 12mo SKU MFN with reseller carveouts)? If yes, we will push to sign and route the DocuSign immediately (link in original packet).

Elliot

--
Elliot Shaw
Director, Procurement Operations
Bluestreak Systems
